requirements.text: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.**
Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science or a related field, with 1+ year of web development experience (internships included). Recent graduates with strong fundamentals are welcome to apply.
Proficiency in JavaScript / TypeScript and React, with the ability to build pages and UI interactions independently.
Proficiency in at least one backend language (e.g., Node.js, Python, or Java), with the ability to design and implement RESTful APIs independently.
Strong SQL and relational database skills, including schema design and basic query optimization.
Familiarity with Git collaboration workflows, solid debugging skills, and a habit of writing unit tests.
Strong learning ability, ownership, and clear communication; proactively reports progress and risks.
Experience building admin systems, workflows, or automation tools.
Experience integrating third-party APIs, or familiarity with OAuth or Webhooks.
Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD, or cloud deployment.
